tagline: How far are you from the cloud?
description: Measures HTTP latency to 28 cloud regions across AWS, GCP, and Cloudflare, directly from your browser.
locationUnavailableBody: Your IP address could not be geolocated. This usually happens on a VPN, proxy, or with privacy extensions. Without a known location the results have no geographic context.
methodologyNote: Estimated latency via HTTP GET requests (not ICMP ping). Each region is sampled 5 times and the median is shown, which absorbs the cold-start bias of the first request (DNS + TLS handshake). All regions are measured in parallel from your browser. No data leaves your device.
gcpAttribution: GCP endpoints via gcping.com (Google DevRel, Apache 2.0).
cloudflareNote: Cloudflare shows your nearest edge node, not a specific datacenter region.
